headline: A safety net in 14 months, then the path to your first home
sproutSays: You're already doing the hard part: steady income and a clear goal. Let's build your family's cushion first so the house never puts you at risk.

stepOne.title: Open FirstRate Savings and name it "Safety net"

matches.explanation: Security matters most to you, and right now $1,200 covers less than one month of costs. A dedicated savings account is where your family's cushion grows first.
termsToKnow: $50 minimum to open online ($0 in branch)
$5 monthly fee, waived with a $500 average daily balance
6 transfers or withdrawals a month; $15 for each one over

matches.explanation: Your home is 5 years out, so down-payment money can sit in a 12-month goal CD where it's harder to spend. Your $400 a month easily covers the $25 minimum transfer.
termsToKnow: $100 minimum to open, plus at least $25 a month in transfers

matches.unlockCondition: When 3 months of expenses ($4,950) are saved
matches.explanation: This program was built for buyers like your family: little to no down payment and up to $5,000 toward closing costs. It unlocks once your safety net is in place.
termsToKnow: Little to no down payment required
Up to $5,000 closing cost grant from FNB

bankerSummary: Jordan, young family, steady job, not yet an FNB customer. Take-home $2,400/mo, fixed costs $1,500, debt payments $150, surplus $750/mo, savings $1,200, credit range: fair. Goals: first home ($15,000 down payment + closing in 60 months, P1) and emergency fund (12 months, P2). Plan: FirstRate Savings now, Savers Goal CD for the down payment next, Home Ownership Program once the $4,950 emergency fund is complete. Good lead for a first-time homebuyer conversation.
